product.olivetti-netstrada-5000.summary: The Olimpus NetStrada that supported a second Pentium Pro on the same card.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5000.history: Olivetti offered the Olimpus-based NetStrada 5000 in Silver and Rack cases under the same name.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5000.architec: Memory could grow for the two processors. The BA2320 uses Intel Natoma and supports up to 1 GB with 3.3 V ECC DIMMs.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5000.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5000.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
